Class ShowOtherShipResponse

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.net.events.serverevents.ServerEvent
it.polimi.ingsw.net.events.serverevents.ShowOtherShipResponse
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ShowOtherShipResponse extends ServerEvent
Represents a response event from the server that provides a spaceship layout and the nickname of another player to be shown to the client
